Storybook stories have been created:

* 1:1 image, sale-flag, promo-flag, brand + brand-link, 3 lines title, subtitle, price, strikethrough-price, unit-price, add-to-cart button, more than four colors in the swatch
* Same as before but with a 3:4 image
* 1:1 image, no flags, brand but no link, 2 lines title, subtitle, price, strikethrough-price, add-to-cart button, 3 colors
* 1:1 image, no flags, no brand, 1 line title, subtitle, price, add-to-cart button, 1 color
* 1:1 image, no flags, brand but no link, 1 line title, no subtitle, no add-to-cart button, no colors
* 1:1 transparent png image with selected background color, the rest is up to you

## Technical details

### organism/ProductTile

The tile itself is a regular `<div>`. The image is inside a link, the brand is a link (if brandHref is provided), the title is a link, the swatch is a link, the add-to-cart-button is a LuiButton. This ensures correct focus-order. If the image-link is focused, the focus should be around the whole card (as seen in the focus-explanation (1) in figma)

Some props:

* productId
* href
* image: Media
* imageAspectRatio: 1:1 or 3:4
* flags: array of flag-variant + label
* colors: array of color-swatches, see <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-1">https://laioutr.atlassian.net/browse/THEMES-51</custom>
* colorsPosition: top or bottom
* brand and brandHref (both optional)
* title and titleLines
* subtitle (optional)
* price: Money
* strikethroughPrice: Money (optional)
* unitPrice (Money) and measurementUnit (e.g. "l", so we get e.g. $14.99/l; both optional)
* showAddToCart: boolean
* color: on-light, on-dark

If a strikethroughPrice is given, the price must be displayed in red with the strikethroughPrice next to it.

Clicking on the Add-to-cart button emits an event from the ProductTile component

The tile itself does not have an inherent width.

Please make sure that you click around the playground for this component in figma. If some data is missing on the tile, there will still be a blank space, instead of the tile getting smaller. This is required to always have the same height in all tiles, independent of provided content.

For rendering prices, use `{{ $money(price) }}` in the template: <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-2">https://github.com/laioutr/laioutr/blob/main/packages/frontend-core/src/runtime/app/i18n/plugins/i18nMoney.ts</custom>

Use existing components for ColorSwatches, Button, Media

longDescription:
## Purpose

The ProductTile component serves as the primary building block for product listings, providing a consistent and flexible way to showcase products across category pages, search results, and promotional sliders.

## Use Cases

- Display products in grid layouts on category and search result pages
- Present featured products in homepage sliders and carousels
- Show sale items with original and discounted prices clearly indicated
- Enable quick add-to-cart functionality directly from product listings
- Support brand-focused merchandising with linked brand names
- Accommodate products with multiple color variants via integrated swatches

## Design Rationale

The component maintains consistent height regardless of content variations, ensuring visual alignment in grid layouts. Focus order follows accessibility best practices: image link, brand link (if present), title link, color swatches, then add-to-cart button. The tile emits events rather than handling cart logic internally, enabling flexible integration with various commerce backends. Internationalized price formatting uses the $money helper for proper locale handling.
